summary: AI/ML Engineer with 2+ years of professional experience building and operating production AI systems, LLM agents, and computer vision pipelines for industrial enterprise clients. Strong Python expertise; hands-on with PyTorch, TensorRT, ONNX, Docker, GitHub Actions, and NVIDIA GPU infrastructure.

education.motivation: Enrolled to deepen knowledge in data and AI engineering while actively seeking a job — not a barrier to work, but a deliberate choice to keep learning.
education.flexibility: Willing to drop out of the Masters if the right full-time opportunity comes. The degree is not the goal; the work is.
education.talking_point_guidance: For full-time roles: use the Masters enrolment as a positive signal of continuous learning, and if relevant, mention that he is fully open to leaving the programme for the right opportunity — it is not a commitment that blocks him. For working student (Werkstudent) roles: omit or downplay this framing, as it is already expected that a working student is enrolled.

education.grades_usage_guidance: Use selected grades as supporting detail when they strengthen the application. For AI/ML roles highlight: Deep Learning 1.0, Computer Vision 1.0, Machine Learning 1.3, AI Applications 1.0. For robotics/CV roles add Autonomous Robotics 1.7. For software/backend roles add Software Engineering 1.7, Algorithms 2.3. Do not list all grades at once — pick 3 to 5 most relevant ones. Overall GPA 2.1 is decent but not the headline; only mention it if the JD asks for it.

voice_guide: Personal, specific, genuine. Connect to real details about the company. No corporate jargon. Honest about gaps. Advanced but natural English.
